title: Magnetar field dynamics driven by chiral anomalies without magnetic helicity
summary: The chiral magnetic effect (CME), arising from the chiral anomaly and enabling a mutual conversion between magnetic topology and fermionic chirality, is a key mechanism in magnetar field evolution. Previous work by Dehman & Pons (2025) demonstrated that the CME can efficiently generate dipolar fields $\left(B_{\rm dip} \gtrsim 10^{14}\,\mathrm{G}\right)$, consistent with magnetar timing measurements, provided that the initial magnetic field carries net helicity.
